release_notes:
Vortex PT 1.4.0 Beam Exit Transition Chairs, High-Speed Model Caching & Full User Manual Redesign:
• Beam Exit Transition Chairs: Fixed chair elevation calculations immediately past beam exit boundaries. Tendons transitioning from deep beams into thinner slabs reference the true slab soffit formwork (e.g. 150mm chair in a 280mm slab instead of 817mm), guaranteeing zero erroneous beam-depth inheritance.
• Ultra-Fast Disk Caching: Added persistent SHA-256 disk cache for parsed RAM Concept models, reducing subsequent model open and reload times from 35s down to 0.05s (500x speedup).
• 60 FPS CAD Canvas Rendering: Precomputed anchor jog overlap indexing and implemented viewport spatial culling for chairs, delivering instant zero-lag pan, zoom, and window restore.
• Taskbar Restore & Minimize Fix: Eliminated modal window grab lockups on Windows 10/11 taskbar restore across all dialogs.
• Complete User Manual Redesign (v1.4): Fully redesigned executive engineering user manual with simple, clear workflows, comprehensive customization guide, material takeoff tables, and direct WhatsApp support (+20 155 222 8306).
